title: Publish/subscribe: one event, many consumers

kcs.statement: In publish/subscribe every subscription on a topic receives its own copy of each message, whereas a point-to-point queue delivers each message to only one consumer.
Publishers do not know their subscribers, so a new downstream service (for example analytics) can subscribe to a topic without any change to the publishing service.
